ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the Library
   D. where is the library

2. When practising Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.

3. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.

4. When practising Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.

5. When practising Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.

6. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.

7. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. went
   C. going
   D. goes

8. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.

9. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.

11. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

12. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. No full stops

13. When practising Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.

15. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. happiness
   C. quickly
   D. run

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 13.1.1 Extensive Listening: Poems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Extensive Listening: Poems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 13.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension strategies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 13.4.1 Short Story: Style and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Narrative Composition 14.5.1 Descriptive writing 15.5.1 Functional Writing – not and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
